segments.name: 01_opening
segments.text: An AI agent can choose what to buy, but it should never decide how much authority it has. PACT is the permission layer between AI intent and money movement.

segments.name: 02_problem
segments.text: An unrestricted payment credential turns a model mistake or prompt injection into financial loss. A confirmation dialog is not a boundary; it is UI state. PACT decides whether a proposal is allowed.

segments.name: 03_solution
segments.text: PACT separates four decisions: AI proposes, PACT verifies against a signed mandate, the owner authorizes exceptions, and PayPal processes. The agent never gets a payment secret.

segments.name: 04_dashboard
segments.text: This is a real Postgres-backed account. Mandates, blocked evaluations and signed audit events are persisted records. PayPal is not configured, so no payment is claimed.

segments.name: 05_mandate
segments.text: Authority is a signed instrument. This mandate fixes a two-hundred-dollar ceiling, fifty dollars per transaction, four authorizations, an expiry, one merchant and one category. PACT rebuilds the payload at decision time. Change a signed field and the proof breaks.

segments.name: 06_agent
segments.text: The agent has its own Ed25519 identity, so every proposal is attributable. Only the public half is exposed. It can propose, but cannot approve itself or reach PayPal credentials.

segments.name: 07_payment
segments.text: The agent selects from the server-controlled catalog and creates a signed proposal. PACT re-checks signature, ownership, status, expiry, merchant, category, amount, budget, count, replay and delegation. The proposal is authorized and the budget is reserved atomically. This is still not a payment.

segments.name: 08_trace
segments.text: Here is the boundary. PACT authorized thirty-eight dollars and reserved it locally. PayPal approval has not started, no order exists, and no capture exists.

segments.name: 09_security
segments.text: Each scenario ran against the real engine with a signed harness mandate and a manipulated proposal. Prompt injection is treated as text, merchant substitution is blocked, replay is rejected, and concurrent spending is serialized by a row lock.

segments.name: 10_decision
segments.text: This is a rejected proposal, not a settlement. Forty dollars exceeded the remaining budget. Sixteen checks passed, one failed, and PayPal was never reached. No transaction is created.

segments.name: 11_delegation
segments.text: Delegation is attenuated. The child receives only a subset of the parent's budget, scope and expiry. When the parent is revoked, the child is withdrawn even though its signature remains valid.

segments.name: 12_audit
segments.text: Every sensitive action appends a hash-chained, signed record. The page recomputes the chain: one hundred percent integrity, zero signature failures. This is application evidence, not immutable storage.

segments.name: 13_paypal
segments.text: No PayPal Sandbox credentials exist here. PACT fails closed and will not fabricate a payment. The loopback contract test proves the adapter, not a genuine Sandbox transaction. Live verification is still pending.

segments.name: 14_close
segments.text: AI proposes. PACT verifies. The owner authorizes. PayPal processes. Bounded, auditable permission to buy, without giving the agent the keys.
